title: Traffic Jam online-only enforcement (block offline play + PWA no-offline caching)

requirements.summary: Block gameplay whenever the device is offline, show a blocking UI, and auto/unblock or provide a clear continue action when connectivity returns.
acceptanceCriteria: If the device is offline, the app does not allow starting or continuing gameplay and instead shows a blocking UI stating that an internet connection is required.
If the connection drops while the app is open, gameplay is immediately blocked and the user is prompted to reconnect.
When the connection is restored, the user can proceed back into the game without a full manual reset (e.g., a clear retry / continue action or auto-unblock).

file_operations.description: Create a small React hook that tracks online/offline state using navigator.onLine plus window 'online'/'offline' events, exposing a boolean and an optional 'recheck' helper for a retry button.

Add a full-screen blocking overlay component (composed from existing shadcn-ui primitives, do not edit frontend/src/components/ui) that explains an internet connection is required and includes a clear Retry/Continue action. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Integrate the online/offline hook and render the OnlineRequiredBlocker overlay when offline; ensure gameplay state can resume without resetting when connectivity returns (do not force restart unless the user explicitly chooses).

Add an explicit 'paused/blocked' prop (driven by offline state) and ensure the 3D game loop (useFrame) does not advance score, movement, spawns, or collisions while blocked; preserve current positions so play can continue after reconnect.

requirements.summary: Adjust the PWA service worker so the game cannot function offline (no caching of game JS/assets), while still serving offline.html for offline navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: When offline, navigation requests resolve to the existing offline page (offline.html).
When offline, game JS/assets are not served from cache in a way that enables gameplay.

After installing the PWA and loading the game once, turning on airplane mode prevents gameplay and shows the offline blocking experience (either the offline page on reload or the in-app blocker if already open).

file_operations.description: Update caching strategy to keep only the dedicated offline fallback (frontend/public/offline.html) and minimal static assets (e.g., icons) cached; remove/avoid caching '/' and remove the runtime cache-put behavior for fetched assets so game JS/assets are not available from cache. Keep navigation handling so offline navigations resolve to offline.html.

requirements.summary: Update Help/About to clearly state in English that Traffic Jam requires an active internet connection and does not support offline play.
acceptanceCriteria: The Help/About panel includes a clear English sentence indicating the game requires an internet connection and offline play is not available.
No non-English user-facing text is introduced for this change.

file_operations.description: Add a concise English note in the Help/About content stating that an active internet connection is required and offline play is not supported; ensure all newly added user-facing text is English only.
